causal_findings: The two dispatched failures were real worker/upstream quota-classified failures on one execution account. The runtime correctly recorded both, released occupancy and quarantined that worker; it did not replay either mutation.

The five remaining failures acquired no central execution lease and produced no worker image submission, so no provider generation was reached. The exact local pool beginDispatch versus worker-pre-grant boundary was not persisted per request.
The production differentiator was execution-target eligibility, not Star persona, model, size or persistence. One target completed 5/5 worker submissions; the other failed 2/2 and entered cooldown.

The systemic amplification defect was in the application endpoint circuit: a valid non-2xx response with execution_state=not_accepted was treated as endpoint failure. Two ordinary admission outcomes could therefore open discovery for the entire endpoint, after which later requests failed as relay_discovery_failed despite no confirmed global outage.

The central registry projection still showed the failing account as healthy with a closed circuit while the runtime snapshot showed quota cooldown. The worker-local circuit prevented reuse, but the projection was not a complete live execution-health record.

evidence: Seven request hashes matched seven unique central leases and seven unique worker submissions.
The worker snapshots contained no duplicate jobs, no remaining jobs and no negative or leaked occupancy.
All 12 durable attempts and image receipts reached terminal states; no queued or generating receipt remained.
The focused admission, queue, quarantine, registry-refresh, fairness and no-replay regressions remain green.

observability_gaps: Star attempt persistence retained only the generic relay_unavailable safe code.
Normal image failure finalization replaced the request payload with an empty object, removing the private upstream code and execution state.
Runtime snapshots retained aggregate worker counters but not per-request worker, dispatch timestamp, upstream status or trace correlation.
No per-request relay telemetry rows existed for this time window. The exact five local pre-provider rejection paths cannot be distinguished further without a private per-request admission event.

repair.change: Endpoint discovery circuits are now updated only for transport/fetch failures. A valid HTTP admission, capability or upstream response is not treated as endpoint reachability failure.
repair.regression: scripts/test-image-availability.ts: a valid not-accepted response does not poison endpoint discovery
repair.before_fix: The regression failed: after two valid not_accepted responses, the third request became relay_discovery_failed.
repair.after_fix: The regression passed and all 93 focused relay/admission tests passed; TypeScript and git diff checks passed.

disposition.next_step: Deploy/reload the reviewed source under release authorization, obtain fresh positive capability evidence, then review a separate bounded authorization. Do not replay the seven failures or issue the 24 unallocated opportunities.
